site.name: The Library
site.description: An Infrared Community initiative translating previously untranslated books from around the world into modern, readable English. Free to read, with original texts alongside.

books.title: Sufi Orbits
books.subtitle: The Legacy of the Communal Revolution in the East
books.author: Hadi al-Alawi
books.description: Hadi al-Alawi’s 1997 meditation on Sufism as a tradition of communal revolt, in English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: Materialist Tendencies in Arab-Islamic Philosophy
books.subtitle: A materialist history from pre-Islamic Arabia through Ibn Sīnā
books.arabicTitle: النزعات المادية في الفلسفة العربية - الإسلامية
books.author: Husayn Muruwwa
books.description: Husayn Muruwwa’s four-volume history of Arab-Islamic philosophy, from pre-Islamic Arabia through Ibn Sīnā, in English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: Patience and Victory
books.subtitle: Lessons from Karbala
books.author: Sayyid Hassan Nasrallah
books.description: Sayyid Hassan Nasrallah’s lessons from Karbala, in English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: Religion and Socialism
books.author: Khaled Mohieddin
books.description: Khaled Mohieddin’s essays on Islam, social justice and socialism, in English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: Right and Left in Islam
books.author: Ahmad Abbas Saleh
books.description: Ahmad Abbas Saleh’s social history of the political struggles of early Islam, in English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: Heroes Without History
books.subtitle: Greek Mythology and Arab Legends
books.author: Fadel al-Rubaie
books.description: Fadel al-Rubaie traces Greek myths inside the Arab legends of al-Tabari, Ibn Hisham and al-Masʿudi. In English with the Arabic original alongside.

books.title: The City of Isis
books.subtitle: The True History of the Arabs
books.author: Pierre Rossi
books.description: Pierre Rossi’s 1976 history of the Arab world and its place in the formation of European civilization, in English with the complete French original alongside.

books.title: Sophia
books.subtitle: Philosophy and Phenomenology
books.author: Alexandre Kojève
books.description: Alexandre Kojève’s manuscript on wisdom, philosophy and phenomenology, translated from its French edition.

books.title: Glossarium
books.subtitle: Notes from the Years 1947 to 1958
books.author: Carl Schmitt
books.description: Carl Schmitt’s private journal from 1947 to 1958, translated from the expanded 2015 German edition, with facsimiles.

materialist-tendencies.title: Materialist Tendencies in Arab-Islamic Philosophy
materialist-tendencies.arabicTitle: النزعات المادية في الفلسفة العربية - الإسلامية
materialist-tendencies.author: Husayn Muruwwa
materialist-tendencies.lead: A sweeping alternative history of Arab-Islamic philosophy, from pre-Islamic Arabia through Ibn Sīnā, organised around a Marxist reading of social history, intellectual conflict and the development of philosophical thought. All four volumes are freely available in modern English alongside the Arabic text.

volumes.title: Pre-Islamic Arabia — The Rise and Early Period of Islam
volumes.blurb: Method, pre-Islamic society, the rise of Islam, and the era of the Rightly Guided Caliphs.

volumes.title: The Muʿtazila — Ashʿarism — Logic
volumes.blurb: The roots of philosophical thought: Shiʿa, Kharijites, Muʿtazila, Ashʿarism, and formal logic.

volumes.title: The Development of Philosophy — Sufism — The Brethren of Purity
volumes.blurb: Sufism, the Brethren of Purity, the natural sciences, and the maturing philosophical tradition.

volumes.title: al-Kindī — al-Fārābī — Ibn Sīnā
volumes.blurb: The mature philosophical stage through al-Kindī, al-Fārābī, and Ibn Sīnā.
